title: Liveline
description: A real-time canvas chart for live values: a smooth line with a live dot and value badge, candlesticks that morph into a line, multiple series, and a cross-fade wrapper.
docs:
Installed `Liveline` and `LivelineTransition` in `components/liveline` (no dependencies beyond React). First, render it inside an element with a height and feed it points as they arrive: ```tsx import { Liveline } from "@/components/liveline"
``` - `data` is `{ time, value }[]` with `time` in Unix seconds; `value` is the latest value. - `mode="candle"` with `candles`, `candleWidth` and `onModeChange` adds a line/candle toggle; `series` draws several lines. - `theme` (`"light"` or `"dark"`) and `color` drive the canvas palette; it does not read your CSS tokens, so pass the theme your page is in. - Give the chart an `aria-label`; the canvas also gets a generated text summary, and arrow keys scrub it when focused. - The unselected window labels keep the upstream look (low contrast, about 1.6:1). When the user asks for more contrast (`prefers-contrast: more`) or forced colors are on, both label states rise above 4.5:1.

props.name: data
props.description: Points to draw, `{ time, value }` with `time` in Unix seconds, oldest first. Points outside the window are skipped.

props.name: value
props.description: The latest value. The line, dot and badge ease toward it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Canvas palette. Match it to the surface the chart sits on.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent color (hex or rgb) for the line, fill, dot and badge.

props.name: window
props.description: Visible time span in seconds.

props.name: windows
props.description: Shows window buttons above the chart; the first is selected. Pair with `onWindowChange`.

props.name: windowStyle
props.description: Look of the window, mode and series buttons.

props.name: mode
props.description: Candle mode draws `candles` (OHLC) of `candleWidth` seconds, plus the live `liveCandle`.

props.name: lineMode
props.description: Candle mode only: morphs the candles into a line (uses `lineData` and `lineValue` for tick detail).

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Shows the built-in line/candle toggle and reports clicks.

props.name: series
props.description: Several lines on shared axes, each `{ id, data, value, color, label? }`; adds toggle chips when there are two or more.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a breathing placeholder line, then morphs into the chart when data arrives.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes scrolling; resuming catches up smoothly.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Text of the empty state.

props.name: grid / badge / fill / pulse / momentum
props.description: Toggle the value grid, the live value badge, the area fill, the pulse ring and the momentum arrows (`momentum` also accepts "up" | "down" | "flat").

props.name: scrub
props.description: Crosshair on hover, touch and keyboard (the canvas becomes focusable).

props.name: onHover
props.description: Called with the scrubbed point (line and multi-series modes), or null when scrubbing ends.

props.name: formatValue / formatTime
props.description: Label formatters (defaults: two decimals, HH:MM:SS). Also used in the accessible summary.

props.name: referenceLine
props.description: A horizontal reference line.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the canvas ("Live candlestick chart" in candle mode).

props.name: className / style
props.description: Applied to the element that holds the canvas (height 100% by default).

props.name: LivelineTransition active
props.description: Key of the child chart to show; the others cross-fade out.

props.name: LivelineTransition duration
props.description: Cross-fade length in milliseconds (0 under reduced motion).

a11y: The canvas has role="img", an accessible name (`aria-label`) and a generated description that follows the props: the latest value and trend, the latest candle, or each series, plus the time window.

With `scrub` on, the canvas is focusable: Left and Right move the crosshair (Shift for bigger steps), Home and End jump to the oldest and latest point, Escape clears it. Each move is announced once in a polite live region.
The window, line/candle and series buttons are native buttons with `aria-pressed`, in labelled groups; the icon-only mode buttons have labels, and focus shows a ring in the `ring` token color.

Contrast: by default the unselected window and series labels keep upstream's faint color (about 1.6:1 on the surface), below WCAG 1.4.3. With prefers-contrast: more or forced-colors: active, both selected and unselected labels rise to at least 4.5:1 (about 7:1), and under forced colors the selected window is underlined because the sliding indicator disappears.
The floating value badge is aria-hidden because the description already states the value.

Under prefers-reduced-motion the chart still scrolls with live data, but easing snaps, the loading line, pulse rings, arrows and candle glow stop moving, degen particles and shake are off, and `LivelineTransition` swaps without fading. The outgoing chart in a transition is inert.
Right-to-left: the button row starts on the inline-start side, but the plot stays left to right because it is a time axis (the canvas container is dir="ltr").
